Title: Retrieve all orders for a shop sorted by order date descending
Preconditions: A shop with at least two existing orders having different order dates
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/orders/shop/{shopId}, replacing {shopId} with the actual shop ID.
2. Verify the response status and order of the results.
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing a list of order summaries sorted by orderDate in descending order (newest first). Each order summary includes: orderId, shopName, customerName, totalAmount, paidAmount, dueAmount, orderDate, trialDate, deliveryDate, status.
